question: How many customers are there?
ai_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Customer;

question: Which countries do customers come from?
ai_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Country FROM Customer WHERE Country IS NOT NULL ORDER BY Country;

question: How many tracks are in the database?
ai_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track;

question: List all genres.
ai_sql: SELECT GenreId, Name FROM Genre;

question: What is the total sales revenue?
ai_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) AS TotalSalesRevenue FROM Invoice;

question: Top 5 countries by revenue
ai_sql: SELECT BillingCountry AS Country, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS Revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Top 5 artists by revenue
ai_sql: SELECT ar.ArtistId, ar.Name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS Revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which album has the most tracks?
ai_sql: SELECT a.AlbumId, a.Title, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Album a JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId GROUP BY a.AlbumId, a.Title ORDER BY TrackCount DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Revenue by year
ai_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS Year, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS Revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY Year ORDER BY Year;

question: Average invoice amount per country
ai_sql: SELECT BillingCountry AS Country, AVG(Total) AS AverageInvoiceAmount FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY AverageInvoiceAmount DESC;

question: Number of tracks per genre
ai_sql: SELECT g.Name AS Genre, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Genre g LEFT JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC;

question: Which sales rep generated the most revenue?
ai_sql: SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalRevenue FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Customers who spent more than $45 in total
ai_sql: SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.Email, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.Email HAVING SUM(i.Total) > 45 ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC;

question: Longest track, in minutes
ai_sql: SELECT Name, Milliseconds / 60000.0 AS Minutes FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Top genre in each country by revenue
ai_sql:
WITH genre_country AS (
    SELECT i.BillingCountry AS Country,
           g.Name AS Genre,
           SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS Revenue
    FROM InvoiceLine il
    JOIN Invoice i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
    LEFT JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
    GROUP BY i.BillingCountry, g.Name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT Country, Genre, Revenue,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Country ORDER BY Revenue DESC) AS rn
    FROM genre_country
)
SELECT Country, Genre, Revenue
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY Country;

question: Month-over-month revenue change in the latest year
ai_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS month,
         SUM(Total) AS revenue
  FROM Invoice
  GROUP BY month
),
with_change AS (
  SELECT month,
         revenue,
         LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT month,
       ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
       ROUND(prev_revenue, 2) AS prev_revenue,
       ROUND(revenue - prev_revenue, 2) AS change,
       ROUND((revenue - prev_revenue) * 100.0 / prev_revenue, 2) AS pct_change
FROM with_change
WHERE substr(month, 1, 4) = (SELECT strftime('%Y', MAX(InvoiceDate)) FROM Invoice)
ORDER BY month;

question: Customers who never bought a Rock track
ai_sql:
SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.Email
FROM Customer c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Invoice i
    JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
    JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
    WHERE i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
      AND g.Name = 'Rock'
);

question: Each sales rep's percentage share of total revenue
ai_sql: SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS SalesRep, SUM(i.Total) AS Revenue, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(i.Total) / (SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice), 2) AS PercentOfRevenue FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName ORDER BY PercentOfRevenue DESC;

question: Customers who made a purchase in every year
ai_sql:
SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName
FROM Customer c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Invoice i
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Invoice i2
    WHERE i2.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
      AND strftime('%Y', i2.InvoiceDate) = strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate)
  )
)

question: Who are our best customers?
ai_sql: SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.Email, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent, COUNT(i.InvoiceId) AS InvoiceCount FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.Email ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 10;
